---
title: "Christabel Rose Coleridge - Giftie the Changeling"
book_id: 500
---

## Publication Information

**Date:** 1869

**Imprint:** London: Warne

**Notes:** This story first appeared in the <i>Barnacle</i> and was subsequently published by Warne in 1869 under the initials C. C.; it is not identified as her work in the British Library catalogue. The last extant volume of the <i>Barnacle</i> (Michaelmas 1867) has the beginning of the story.
